title: CamSpokenNLI: A Pilot Resource for Cross-Variety Transfer Evaluation in Cameroon Pidgin English and Camfranglais
abstract: arXiv:2611.17573v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cameroon Pidgin English (a West African Pidgin English variety) and Camfranglais are widely used in Cameroon, yet to our knowledge, neither has a dedicated spoken Natural Language Inference (NLI) resource. We introduce CamSpokenNLI, a pilot dataset of 114 scenario-matched spoken NLI items in each variety (228 in total), recorded by one native speaker from Buea. Each item pairs premise audio and text with a hypothesis, an NLI label, and English glosses. The author assigned labels, so the dataset is an exploratory resource rather than a mature benchmark. The NLI experiments use the reference text; the audio is evaluated separately. XLM-RoBERTa baselines with five-fold item-level cross-validation reach 44.7% on Pidgin and 46.2% on Camfranglais (chance 33.3%). translated_title: CamSpokenNLI：用于喀麦隆皮钦英语与Camfranglais跨变体迁移评估的试点资源
translated_abstract: 喀麦隆皮钦英语（西非皮钦英语的一种变体）和Camfranglais在喀麦隆被广泛使用，但据我们所知，这两种语言变体目前都没有专门的口语自然语言推理（NLI）资源。我们推出了CamSpokenNLI，这是一个试点数据集，包含每种变体114个场景匹配的口语NLI条目（共228条），由一位来自布埃亚的母语者录制。每个条目将前提音频和文本与假设、NLI标签以及英文注释配对。由于标签由作者本人分配，该数据集属于探索性资源，而非成熟的基准。NLI实验使用参考文本；音频则单独评估。采用五折条目级交叉验证的XLM-RoBERTa基线在皮钦英语上达到44.7%的准确率，在Camfranglais上达到46.2%（随机水平为33.3%）。尽管如此，两者的结果在统计上均无法与仅使用假设的输入区分开来，因此假设的措辞可能构成了准确率的主要来源。在不相交条目的跨变体迁移条件下……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文推出了首个面向喀麦隆皮钦英语和Camfranglais两种语言变体的口语自然语言推理试点数据集CamSpokenNLI（共228条条目），实验发现XLM-RoBERTa基线表现仅略高于随机水平且与仅使用假设的输入难以区分，凸显了这些低资源变体上NLI任务的挑战性。
en_tdlr: We introduce CamSpokenNLI, a pilot spoken NLI dataset of 228 scenario-matched items in Cameroon Pidgin English and Camfranglais, and show that XLM-RoBERTa baselines perform only slightly above chance and are statistically indistinguishable from hypothesis-only input, highlighting the challenges of NLI in these low-resource varieties.
